name: approvals-sql
title: Approvals: exact actions a person approves, recorded by code
description: Stores approvals of exact actions (an action's hash, who may decide, its expiry) on storage.sql, owned by one actor: decided once by an allowed approver, claimed at most once by the call that runs it.

approvals.summary: Exact actions waiting for a person's approval: decided by allowed approvers, each approved action claimed at most once.
